'''Andrew Paul Hendry''' (born March 24, 1968) is a Canadian biologist and professor in the Department of Biology and the [[Redpath Museum]] at [[McGill University]]. He holds [[dual citizenship]] of both [[Canada]] and [[the United States]]. He has been named a tier 1 [[Canada Research Chair]] from 2018 to 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Andrew Hendry CV |url=http://redpath-staff.mcgill.ca/hendry/CVHendry.pdf |access-date=2020-06-04 |website=Redpath Museum}}</ref>
